name: Send accepted
description: One compact click with a tiny muted note.

name: Added to queue
description: Three diminishing taps, ending with a low warm hint.

name: Upload ready
description: Two clicks open a small ascending three-note flourish.

name: Completion — resolve
description: A round pair with a descending, settled chime.

name: Question — open interval
description: A patient pair followed by two gently rising notes.

name: Needs attention
description: Two broader taps and a restrained downward step.

name: Microphone on
description: A light opening pair with a quick upward fifth.

name: Microphone off
description: The closing counterpart: broader click and downward fifth.

name: Connection restored
description: Three growing taps land on a soft two-note harmony.

name: Undo / restore
description: Two reversed-weight clicks with a brief falling chime.
